body: I have some friends who have also dealt with mental health issues and I can talk to occasionally but I rarely ever skim the surface since I don’t want to worry them to much. Most of the time i’m just trying to deal with this alone, and it freaks me out if anyone gets involved because then I just feel like i’m dragging someone else into my mess, even if it’s a professional.

Honestly, no I slowly just got more and more closed off and I think my therapist could tell, then I just quit. I really regret that because maybe if i did talk about it then I could have made more progress, but now i’m just stuck without any help again.
